crossRefs.note: One day he came there, and he went to the room and lay there.

translations.web: One day he came there, and he went to the room and lay there.
translations.bsb: One day Elisha came to visit and went to his upper room to lie down.
translations.kjv: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.
translations.asv: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber and lay there.
